**Claude finished @Helw150's task in 5m 17s** —— [View job](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/actions/runs/32778706265)

### Code review

No high-signal issues found. Checked for correctness bugs and CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md compliance across the two new modules and the test changes.

I traced the parts most likely to hide a bug:

- **Length partition token slicing** (`length_partition.py`) — `_selected_token_chunks` emits maximal contiguous runs of selected docs as `[starts[first], ends[last-1])`, chunked at `READ_CHUNK_ELEMENTS`. Concatenated across runs in document order, this matches the selected documents' tokens exactly, so `write_bucket_cache` re-splits correctly by `selected_lengths` (same mask, same order). The unselected-first and single-doc cases check out.
- **Threshold boundary** — `is_long = lengths > 65_536` puts a 65 536-token doc in `lte_64k` and 65 537 in `gt_64k`, matching "at or below 64K / above 64K." The boundary test in `test_datakit_store.py` pins this.
- **Sharded-leaf load** — `TreeCache.load` on an individual `finished_shards` subpath is a real contract (same pattern as `consolidate_shard_caches._probe_shard`), so `_source_leaf_groups` is fine.
- **Ledger merge** — `_merge_buckets` passes per-shard token counts through the separate `field_counts` argument of `_merge_sharded_ledgers`; the empty `field_counts` on the constructed ledgers is expected.
- **Resume/sidecar** — sidecar written last via `atomic_rename` with a fresh `attempt` UUID per run, so a crash-and-retry never collides with orphaned partial shards.

- **Mixture math** (`long_context_datakit_moe_mix.py`) — per cell, `lte + gt = bucket_weight` (mass preserved), `gt/lte = skew · long/short` (skew multiplies the long-to-short ratio exactly), and skew=1 reduces to the token-proportional `short/(short+long)`, `long/(short+long)` split. Confirmed against the two tests.
- **Division by zero** — the denominator `short + skew·long` is zero only when `short_tokens == 0`; no cell in `_BUCKET_LENGTH_TOKENS` has zero short tokens (the only zeros are `long_tokens`), so it's unreachable. `LONG_CONTEXT_SKEW <= 0` is rejected.
- **Key/cache consistency** — `lte_64k` is emitted unconditionally and `gt_64k` gated on `long_tokens` in both `long_context_phase_weights` and `long_context_datakit_components`, so their keys match; every `lte` key has a nonzero weight and a cache the partition step always writes. The 191 long cells (200 minus the 9 zero-`long_tokens` cells) match the PR description.

The PR title and description follow the writing-style guide — plain, leads with what changed and why, no boilerplate or attribution.
 · `held/long-context-cooldown-mixture`

comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the source store region-local**

When this artifact is launched anywhere outside `us-central2`, every partition worker reads the very large source store directly across regions because the source is fixed to this GCS URL while `build()` imposes no region constraint. That can exhaust the transfer budget or incur a full-store cross-region transfer; adopt a region-aware `mirror://` source after the required approval, or explicitly constrain this recipe to the source region.

AGENTS.md reference: [experiments/AGENTS.md:L30-L33](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/blob/fdd2c7ba40a5a5522b1f52a0b96098b7738ee8fc/experiments/AGENTS.md#L30-L33)
